name: Cabrillo up the coast of California
traveler: Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo and Bartolomé Ferrer
summary: Three small ships from New Spain sail up an unknown coast looking for wealth and a passage to Asia. Cabrillo is the first European to enter San Diego Bay and see the coast of California; he dies of an infected wound on the Channel Islands, and his pilot Ferrer pushes on north to about Oregon.

stops.note: Three ships leave the Pacific port of Navidad.
'A very good enclosed port.' The Kumeyaay meet them.
Chumash towns along the coast, with plank canoes.
Storms drive them past without seeing the bay's shelter.
Cabrillo dies of gangrene after a fall.
Ferrer, now in command, reaches perhaps 42°N before turning back.
Home, with no gold and no passage.
